opening.argument: The video presents practical instruction on growing an Instagram account through ordinary engagement features and phone tools. Its stated subject is “10 Five Minute Hacks To Grow Your Instagram FAST,” and the speaker introduces “10 five minute hacks to grow your instagram,” including direct-message responses and text replacement. The competition example offers only a shout-out for commenting and enabling notifications; it requires no payment, credentials, or deception, and describes no guaranteed outcome. The evidence therefore supports an educational demonstration of audience-engagement techniques.
